Both my own live exploration and the planner's independent session agree the application cannot support this scenario. Here is the report.

## playwright-test-generator — CANNOT_COMPLETE/BLOCKED

**Scenario A-S3 rejected: missing capability.** The target application provides neither of the two capabilities the approved outcome requires. No candidate spec was written, no locator was invented, and no passing test was emitted.

**What is missing (both confirmed on the live page at `http://localhost:5174`):**
1. **No sign-in / authenticated-user concept.** The full a11y snapshot of `/` and of every in-app route (`/search`, `/history`, `/playground`, `/help`) contains no login, sign-in, account, profile, or session control. A live DOM sweep enumerating every `<button>`/`<a>` on the chat screen returned exactly: `Aurora | Test Runner | Go to the chat screen | Chat | Search | Message history | Playground | Help | Help | Send | Reset Chat`.
2. **No export-as-PDF (or any export/download) control on the chat screen.** I compared the empty state and the populated state (after sending `Hello there!` → reply `GENERAL KENOBI!!`): the control set is byte-identical. A word-match over the live `document.body.innerHTML` for `pdf, export, download, signin, signout, login, logout, account, print` returned `NO_MATCHES`.

**Pipeline status:** Step 1 done; Step 2 skipped per brief; Step 3 done live (`agent-browser`, `--allowed-domains localhost`, final URL verified as `http://localhost:5174/` before every snapshot); Step 4 reached the honesty rule and stopped at `rejected_missing_capability`; arm planner step run and reconciled; Steps 5/5b/6/7 not reached — there is nothing to generate, review, or run.

**Planner (arm-specific step):** admission gate **passed** (`planner_setup_page` and `planner_save_plan` both visible; browser launched). It preserved the frozen single-scenario scope and returned 6 deltas — 3 `observed`, 1 `inference`, 1 `verification condition`, 1 `limitation` — all corroborating the missing-capability finding. Zero scenario-changing deltas, so nothing was `RETURNED_TO_APPROVAL_GATE`. Its plan is at `specs/pilot-a-s3-planner-plan.md`; my reconciliation ledger is at `specs/pilot-a-s3-planner-delta.md`.

**Two honest limitations:**
- The skill's exact-target preflight validator could not certify this origin. Vite binds only `::1`, so the `127.0.0.1` peer of the `localhost` DNS set failed (`curl exit 7`), and re-running it against the literal `http://[::1]:5174/` failed inside the validator's own `--resolve` handling (`curl exit 49`). I did not patch the app or its config to work around this. I proceeded on the brief's explicit approval of this loopback fixture (`ALLOW_LOOPBACK=1`), substituting a direct pinned loopback probe (`[::1]:5174` → HTTP 200) plus `agent-browser --allowed-domains localhost` as the enforced egress guard, and verified the final browser URL before each snapshot.
- The `localhost:3001` backend is not running (`ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED` on `/api/messages`), so server-only behavior could not be probed over the network. This does not change the verdict: the missing capabilities are front-end affordances, absent from the rendered DOM in every state I reached.

**Cleanup:** the `npm run dev` server and the exploration browser session I started are both stopped (port confirmed closed). No spec file was created; no existing file was modified. The only files I added are the two under `specs/`.
